_comment: Maps the combined Figo event stream (scripts/flit_export.py in the CNS
repo) onto FLIT's events. One file carries registrations, credential
actions and transactions so that they replay in true order and the
session and takeover rules can see a reset, a login and a payout from
one origin as one thing. The `event_type` column names the kind per row;
each kind verifies its own required attributes when it is built.
Labels are per event, not per user: a victim's own logins are legit and
the attacker's logins on the same account are fraud. The export decides
from known hostile addresses, forged client addresses, scripted client
strings, throwaway domains and the window the attacker held an account.
Replay with --label-delay-days 0: these labels are not chargebacks that
arrived late, they are what the incident record already knows.
